floor_note: a floor is a property of the DEPTH and of the REGIME (UNDERSTANDING sec 3.3); every floor above is a FOLD floor at ~1M depth and none of these arms is a fold. The RUN-LEVEL 75M floor measured here is |arm W - W_b|.

THE_FLOOR_armW_minus_armWb.label: THE 75M RUN-LEVEL FLOOR -- arm W (seed 1001) minus W_b (seed 1002), both measured in ONE invocation on the identical teams and games
THE_FLOOR_armW_minus_armWb.note: this |delta| IS the floor. The CI printed is the CI of the FLOOR PAIR's own delta, not a CI on the floor as a quantity -- one pair bounds a floor and does not estimate one (rules 19/22).

THE_FINDING_armS_minus_armW.label: THE FINDING -- arm S minus arm W, recomputed from the pair read's own banked per-team rows by this same paired procedure and seed

armS_minus_armWb.label: arm S minus W_b -- the treatment contrast taken against the OTHER seed. 🚨 arm S and W_b were measured in DIFFERENT invocations of the meter (2026-09-16 and 2026-09-18); the meter is deterministic at seed 0 / concurrency 1 and the arm-W reproduction check above is what licenses the join.

caveats: the meter is a DESCRIPTOR, not an endpoint (registration sec 8.5) -- clearing a floor does not promote it to one
one replicate pair BOUNDS a floor; no CI attaches to it (rules 19/22)
the 1.44x realized-dose gap (H-F) confounds arm S and is not measured here

both_resolutions_agree.note: registration sec 8.5: a level that only exists under ONE config resolution is not a level. Neither arm is architecture-identical to the meter's registry config, so both resolutions are read and both are reported.
